role: Abstract base of the target tasks (HurtByTarget, NearestAttackableTarget, and the wolf-only ones): the shared continue/range/suitability logic, including the sight check with a 60-tick unseen grace and the home-distance guard.

members.name: taskOwner
members.note: folded: the task runs on the owning struct living

members.name: nearbyOnly
members.note: ai_task.nearby_only: the golem's NearestAttackableTarget and DefendVillage

members.name: continueExecuting
members.note: the aliveness, followRange distance and 60-tick unseen grace; Java's last check (the target an EntityPlayerMP in creative) is always false: the replayed game type is survival

members.name: getTargetDistance
members.note: the followRange attribute value (attrs_value(ATTR_FOLLOW_RANGE)); the null fallback 16.0 is unreachable because EntityLiving registers the attribute

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: targetSearchStatus/Delay = 0 and field_75298_g = 0; the native starts clear target_unseen_ticks

members.name: resetTask
members.note: setAttackTarget(null) -> attack_target = NULL in the shared AIC_HURT_BY_TARGET/AIC_NEAREST_ATTACKABLE_TARGET case

members.name: isSuitableTarget
members.note: the null/self/alive checks, canAttackClass (creeper, ghast, the player-built golem sparing players), the home-distance guard, the sight check and the nearbyOnly reach test (ai.c target_nearby_ok: canEasilyReach's delay draw and path end); the IEntityOwnable branch needs a wolf or an ocelot, both switched off

members.name: canEasilyReach
members.note: the 10 + nextInt(5) delay, getPathToEntityLiving and the final point within 1.5 blocks

notes: The class is abstract; every concrete behavior is reachable only through HurtByTarget and NearestAttackableTarget, whose cases share the continue path in ai.c. lane/idxentity: ent-water-s1 pins the nearbyOnly reach test on an iron golem under water (the golem's navigator never swims: EntityIronGolem adds no EntityAISwimming, so its path from under water starts at its feet; ai.c now leaves can_swim off for it).
